hardware.scope_note: analytic symbol counts only (G=visual group count, T=prompt token count, D=128); the prompt reducer runs on the host/Jetson and the scorer on the FPGA.  NOT synthesised and NOT measured on ZCU102; no latency, resource or speedup claim is made.  INT8 bytes assume one signed int8 per element (128-byte 1x128 query / 16-byte 128-bit alignment not modelled here).

preregistration.candidate_selection_rule: the candidate set, its parameters and its order are frozen before the test split is read; no candidate may be added, removed or re-parameterised after test is seen (no post-hoc tuning)

candidates.description: existing baseline: per group max over prompt-token cosines
candidates.name: hard_max

candidates.description: arithmetic mean over all prompt-token cosines
candidates.name: mean_cos

candidates.description: mean of the highest 2 cosines; T<2 uses all
candidates.name: topk_mean_k2

candidates.description: mean of the highest 4 cosines; T<4 uses all
candidates.name: topk_mean_k4

candidates.description: normalise each prompt token Wt projection (existing cosine convention), mean over tokens, re-normalise; every visual group does a single cosine/dot against this one 128-d query
candidates.name: prompt_mean_vector

hardware_cost_contract.scope_note: analytic symbol counts only (G=visual group count, T=prompt token count, D=128); the prompt reducer runs on the host/Jetson and the scorer on the FPGA.  NOT synthesised and NOT measured on ZCU102; no latency, resource or speedup claim is made.  INT8 bytes assume one signed int8 per element (128-byte 1x128 query / 16-byte 128-bit alignment not modelled here).

promotion_gate.A_prompt_sensitivity: same-image-other-task spearman and ndcg_full paired delta > 0, 95% CI lower bound > 0, |dz| >= 0.2 and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05
promotion_gate.B_shuffled_discrimination: cross-image-same-task shuffled spearman and ndcg_full paired delta > 0, 95% CI lower bound > 0, |dz| >= 0.2 and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05
promotion_gate.D_teacher_non_regression: val correct-prompt spearman and ndcg_full both >= hard_max baseline + -0.01
promotion_gate.E_numeric_and_contract: all metrics finite and the hardware contract complete

preregistration.scope: CPU-only frozen-weight scorer-reduction ablation; no training, no tuning, no 4B model load, no GPU, no network, no CV-Bench

statistics.cross_image_donor: fixed-seed deterministic derangement on images (bijective, no self-pair); student donors keep the task
statistics.holm_bonferroni_family: { (candidate, condition, metric) : candidate in NON_BASELINE_CANDIDATES (10 candidates), condition in {same_image_other_task, cross_image_same_task_shuffled}, metric in {spearman, ndcg_full} }; m = 40

test_discipline.no_post_hoc_selection_on_test: if no candidate passes, winner=NO_PROMOTION and the single test evaluation is a frozen diagnostic only and may not be used to pick a candidate

winner_selection_lexicographic: maximise min(same spearman delta, same ndcg_full delta, cross spearman delta, cross ndcg_full delta)
then maximise val correct-prompt spearman + ndcg_full
then minimise per-group MAC/compare/exp and prompt-side transfer bytes
then follow the fixed candidate order

scope: CPU-only frozen-weight scorer-reduction ablation; no training, no tuning, no 4B model load, no GPU, no network, no CV-Bench
